text:
Maya: Dropped a Figma frame for toast dismiss behavior. Prototype currently shifts focus to the primary action after a toast is dismissed and you can see a quick focus flash when people close it with the keyboard. screenshot: https://figma.com/file/abc123 (top-right toasts) Kevin: Saw that. We should avoid reordering the DOM or moving focus unless the user explicitly interacted with the toast. Suggest rendering toasts in a portal so they don't affect document flow. Ria: A11y note: toasts must be announced via ARIA live regions, not by forcing focus. Use role="status" and aria-live="polite" so screen readers get the message without stealing keyboard focus. Ria: Example markup: ```
Saved
``` David: Real problem in the walkthrough: global Esc closes toasts and also closes open modals. During the demo the modal closed when someone hit Esc to dismiss a toast (bad). Maya: Can we scope the Esc handler to only close a toast when the toast or one of its interactive children has focus? Or only when the pointer is over the toast? That avoids conflicting with modal handlers. Kevin: Yep. Register the handler on the toast element and stopPropagation, or check document.activeElement is inside the toast before handling. Also prefer pointer dismiss affordance as default; keyboard users can tab to actions but we shouldn't auto-focus. Ria: Copy & timing: actionable toasts (e.g., "Upload failed Retry") need longer timeout or be persistent until dismissed. Non-actionable can be 4s. Keep copy short: "Saved" or "Copied" instead of long sentences. Maya: Will A/B test 4s vs 8s for actionable toasts. Errors persistent until dismiss. I'll add both timing variants and a persistent state in the prototype. David: Implementation: put toasts in an absolutely positioned container (top-right) to avoid layout shifts. Respect prefers-reduced-motion and remove slide animations for those users. Kevin: I'll open a PR to: 1) move toasts to portal container, 2) change live region to role=status, 3) remove autofocus on dismiss, 4) scope Esc handler. ETA: EOD. design-bot: deploy preview updated: https://deploy.preview/xyz 680 (shows portal + behavior tweak) Maya: Thanks! I'll adjust copy variants and show both timing options in the updated prototype. Ria, can you drop a short a11y QA checklist and a couple of VoiceOver/NVDA notes when you have a minute? Ria: Sure 5f8 will post checklist and quick NVDA/VoiceOver steps tomorrow morning. :white_check_mark:
